title: worktree merge refuses standard/high-risk features without uat approval
action: New zero-mutation merge precondition in merge_stage (phases.rs), after the branch-mismatch check (~:213) and before companion teardown (~:215): resolve the feature via existing resolve_worktree_feature (merge.rs:413-426), map feature to lane from main_root's lane/workflow record; when lane is standard or high-risk (missing/unknown lane counts as standard — fail closed) AND the feature's uat gate is unapproved AND --skip-uat absent AND config uat_before_merge is not explicit false, refuse typed WORKTREE_MERGE_UAT_PENDING with a remedy naming all three exits (approve via bee gate --name uat, or --skip-uat, or config uat_before_merge=false). Config reader models handlers.rs:415-421 but default-ON: absent means true, explicit false disables, non-bool refuses. Wire --skip-uat: FLAG_ALONE_BOOLEANS (flags.rs:31-37), keys_known allowlist (handlers.rs:440), bool validation like cleanup (:446-456), registry_payload.json (try bee dev regen from the main binary first; if no generator, hand-edit and keep registry_contracts.rs green, record which path was taken). Tests: refuse on standard+unapproved; pass on gate approved, on --skip-uat, on config false, on tiny lane; non-bool config refused; refusal is zero-mutation (no teardown started). Depends on ug-1.

truths: Merge of a standard-lane feature without uat approval refuses, zero mutation
Approved gate / --skip-uat / config false / tiny lane all merge
